subject: Commercial clarifications: invoicing entity, tax footnotes & min-commit phasing
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@glimmerlabs.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2024 08:12:22 -0700
Subject: Commercial clarifications: invoicing entity, tax footnotes & min-commit phasing

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per follow-up from our legal and finance teams, I attached the current Order Form (OrderForm_Glimmer_v3.pdf) and have three quick asks so we can finalize the commercial appendix: 

1) Invoicing entity vs. purchaser: the order form currently points at Glimmer Labs, Inc. as the billing party. Can you confirm whether invoices should be raised to the US parent (Glimmer Labs, Inc.) or a local subsidiary for tax residency purposes? If you prefer a local entity, please send the exact remit-to name and tax id we should include on the PO.

2) Taxes and reverse-charge: for EU customers we typically rely on a VAT reverse-charge note with a supplier VAT certificate on file. Do you have a VAT certificate or local tax evidence we can attach? If Glimmer is requesting us to gross up or withhold, flag that now.

3) Minimum commit phasing & invoicing cadence: the pricing schedule lists an annual minimum commit with quarterly invoicing. Glimmer previously asked for a phased ramp (Year 1: 50% commit, Year 2: 100%). We can reflect a staged trigger in the invoice schedule but need the acceptance criteria and PO timing to align. Can you confirm the preferred invoice cadence (quarterly in advance vs. quarterly arrears) and whether you require Net45 terms (your team mentioned that on the call).

Quick next steps:
- If you can confirm entity remit and attach any tax certs, our finance team will prepare the PO instructions.
- If Net45 is required, we’ll check with Finance and loop Legal for the amendment language (this impacts payment terms in the Order Form).

Appreciate a quick reply — goal is to get this into legal redline next week and send to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Commercial Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_Glimmer_v3.pdf (pdf)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear list. Answers below and I attached our VAT certificate for reference.

1) Billing entity: Please bill to Glimmer Labs, Inc. (US parent). We can provide a local subsidiary remit if we move billing to EMEA later, but for the initial contract please use the parent entity. Remit info follows: Glimmer Labs, Inc. 
   - Tax ID: 12-3456789
   - Remit address: 101 Innovation Way, Suite 300, Boston, MA 02110

2) VAT / reverse charge: Attached is our VAT certificate (Tax_Cert_Glimmer.pdf). For EMEA customers we expect reverse-charge treatment; we will not request gross-up.

3) Commit phasing & terms: Glimmer prefers Net45 for strategic partners while we finish internal treasury setup. We plan the phased ramp you mentioned: Year 1 at 50% of annual commit invoiced quarterly in advance (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4) and Year 2 at full commit with quarterly advance invoicing. If Redwood needs Net30, we can escalate, but Net45 is our ask.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps. Also — can you send the DocuSign link once you have the redline?

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Procurement
Glimmer Labs

Attachments: Tax_Cert_Glimmer.pdf (pdf)

Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2024 15:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial clarifications: invoicing entity, tax footnotes & min-commit phasing

Thanks Samira — appreciate the quick turnaround and VAT cert. A few internal notes and proposed edits: 

- Billing entity: fine to bill Glimmer Labs, Inc. for Year 1. We do need the exact remit lines (per Neha) for our AP system — please confirm the address line format in a short email so we can populate the PO. 

- Net terms: Finance preference is Net30; given Glimmer’s request for Net45 we can offer Net45 for Year 1 as a one-time accommodation tied to the phased ramp and subject to PO arrival prior to first invoice. If we agree Net45, we should include a short clause in the Order Form: 
  "Payment Terms: Net45 for the first 12 months subject to PO issuance; thereafter default to Net30 unless otherwise agreed in writing."

- Invoicing cadence & phasing: agree to quarterly invoicing in advance for Year 1 (50% commit). Please confirm that acceptance criteria (usage threshold or activation milestone) are satisfied prior to invoicing Q1. If not, we'll need to shift to arrears for the first quarter.

Action items from Redwood: 
- Neha: incorporate the Net45 footnote and add a billing entity footnote in the Order Form redline.
- Ben: coordinate with Sales to confirm PO timing and whether a purchase order will be issued from Glimmer’s US parent.

I attached a short redline checklist (I’ll add the formal redline once Legal confirms language).

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Looping in a quick next-steps summary so we can keep DocuSign on track: 

1) Glimmer to confirm remit lines in single reply to this thread (we have Tax ID from Samira).
2) Neha to add the Net45 footnote for Year 1 and the billing-entity footnote into the redline.
3) Kim to provide the final redline checklist; Legal to produce the redlined OrderForm_Glimmer_v3_redlined.pdf and route to DocuSign.
4) Sales (Ben) to confirm PO timing — Samira, please confirm expected date for PO issuance so we can schedule first invoice.

Samira — if PO will be issued within two weeks we can proceed with the quarterly-in-advance schedule for Q2 billing. If not, Finance will default Q2 to arrears and we’ll update the redline accordingly. Once Neha has uploaded the redline I’ll upload to HubSpot and request the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks all — aim to have DocuSign sent by next Tuesday.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Accounts Lead
Redwood Inference
